name: CSA
author: Empenn
description: Cross-Sectional Area (CSA) tool. From a given spinal T1w MRI acquisition, this pipeline extracts the spinal cord segmentation and generates cross-sectional area and shape metrics along the cord (per vertebral level and slice), along with a CSV metrics file and a QC image. This pipeline is a series of tools from the SCT (Spinal Cord Toolbox) open-source repository, applied in the following steps: generate the spinal cord segmentation, extract the spinal cord segmentation zone, generate vertebral labelling, and generate CSV metrics. Source: https://github.com/spinalcordtoolbox/spinalcordtoolbox
command-line: echo '--------------ls -l ../------------' && ls -l ; unzip [INPUT] -d INPUTDIR; rename -v 's/\.nii\.gz$/.nii/' INPUTDIR/*.nii.gz; gzip INPUTDIR/*.nii; mkdir OUTPUT; bash /usr/local/bin/launch-script.sh INPUTDIR OUTPUT && cp input_params.json OUTPUT/ && tar -cvzf [OUTPUT_FILE] OUTPUT

inputs.name: T1 Archive
inputs.description: DICOM ZIP archive containing a T1w spinal MRI acquisition.

output-files.description: Tarball containing: csa_c2c3.csv, a table of cross-sectional area and shape metrics computed along the spinal cord (per slice and vertebral level), including Slice (I->S), VertLevel, DistancePMJ, MEAN/STD(area), MEAN/STD(angle_AP), MEAN/STD(angle_RL), MEAN/STD(diameter_AP), MEAN/STD(diameter_AP_ellipse), MEAN/STD(diameter_RL), MEAN/STD(length_anterior), MEAN/STD(length_posterior), MEAN/STD(eccentricity), MEAN/STD(orientation), MEAN/STD(solidity), and SUM(length); and qc.png, a visual quality check showing the input from LR-AP and AP-SI views.
output-files.name: Output archive
